text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek's injury has been fully treated.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um… You're going to make me blush if you keep staring at me like that.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm not pretending! If I just sit still, then it's no big—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There you go staring again. Stop picking on me! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …Honestly, it does hurt, but it's nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm being serious… Okay?
choice_data_list: I'll cry if I find out you're lying, you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm being serious… Okay?
choice_data_list: I'll cry if I find out you're lying, you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …I see. Well, I wouldn't want to make you worry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: All right then. I hate to take advantage of your kindness, but just this once…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Do you think you could stay with me until I'm better? I'm so sorry…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek smiles through the pain to stop me from worrying.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh? Well, that won't do at all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Trainer. It really does hurt a lot.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Gah, what do I do? I don't want you to have a tough time because of me…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Mrgh! B-but it hurts…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After calming the flustered Super Creek, I take my time tending to her injury.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness me. Hehe, silly Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: If I make you cry, I'll just have to own my mistake and comfort you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll give you a biiiiig hug, and then… Oh, right. That means I have to get better fast.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …You're so cute, Trainer. Thanks for everything! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give Super Creek the care that she needs, and she happily pats me on the head.
